arxiv-2104-04604.title: Practical Resources for Enhancing the Reproducibility of Mechanistic Modeling in Systems Biology Journal: Current Opinion in Systems Biology
arxiv-2104-04604.creator: Michael L. Blinov, John H. Gennari, Jonathan R. Karr, Ion I. Moraru, David P. Nickerson, Herbert M. Sauro
arxiv-2104-04604.description: Abstract Although reproducibility is a core tenet of the scientific method, it remains challenging to reproduce many results. Surprisingly, this also holds true for computational results in domains such as systems biology where there have been extensive standardization efforts. For example, Tiwari et al. recently found that they could only repeat 50% of published simulation results in systems biology.

arxiv-2109-11122.creator: Xiaokang Li 1,∗ , Shan Jiang 3,1 , Qingkai Meng 1 , Huakun Zuo 1 , Zengwei Zhu 1,∗ , Leon Balents 2,4 and Kamran Behnia 3
arxiv-2109-11122.description: Abstract The magnetic free energy is usually quadratic in magnetic field and depends on the mutual orientation of the magnetic field and the crystalline axes. Tiny in magnitude, this magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy (MAE) is nevertheless indispensable for the existence of permanent magnets.

arxiv-2110-05600.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by C. J. Ramírez-Valdez, H. García-Compeán, and V. S. Manko. In the present paper, we compute the Euclidean action of a generic system consisting of N N arbitrary Kerr-Newman black holes located on the symmetry axis and separated from each other by massless struts.

arxiv-2308-10827.title: The Temporal Continuum
arxiv-2308-10827.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . The continuum has been one of the most controversial topics in mathematics since the time of the Greeks. Some mathematicians, such as Euclid and Cantor, held the position that a line is composed of points, while others, like Aristotle, Weyl and Brouwer, argued that a line is not composed of points but rather a matrix of a continued insertion of points. In spite of this disagreement on the structure of the continuum, they did distinguish the temporal line from the spatial line .

arxiv-2309-17247.title: The translation invariant product measure problem in non-sigma finite case
arxiv-2309-17247.creator: Nicha Khenkhok
arxiv-2309-17247.description: Abstract We give an example of non-translation invariant product measure obtained from two translation invariant measures, one of which is non-sigma finite. This particular example also suggests that there can be infinitely many product measures if we abandon the sigma-finiteness assumption.

arxiv-2412-10829.title: Interference in Fuzzy Dark Matter Filaments
arxiv-2412-10829.creator: T. Zimmermann, D. J.E. Marsh, K. K. Rogers, H. A. Winther, S. Shen
arxiv-2412-10829.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by T. Zimmermann, D. J.E. Marsh, K. K. Rogers, H. A. Winther, S. Shen. Fuzzy (wave) dark matter (FDM), the dynamical model underlying an ultralight bosonic dark matter species, produces a rich set of non-gravitational signatures that distinguishes it markedly from the phenomenologically related warm (particle) dark matter (WDM) scenario.

arxiv-2511-13127.creator: Zonghao Ying, Moyang Chen, Nizhang Li, Zhiqiang Wang, Wenxin Zhang, Quanchen Zou, Zonglei Jing, Aishan Liu, Xianglong Liu, [2mm] State Key Laboratory of Complex & Critical Software Environment, Beihang University

pmc-11353403.creator: Baoai Wu, Longpeng Li, Longhui Li, Yinghua Chen, Yue Guan, Jinfeng Zhao

pmc-11435297.creator: Huan Xu, Yachao Wang, Xin Hou, Wei Ou, Tao Yang, Yang Mei, Baoping Zhang, Elisabetta Fanizza
pmc-11435297.description: The optical properties of wurtzite violet InGaN/GaN coupled quantum well (QW) structures are experimentally studied using photoluminescence (PL) and electroluminescence (EL) spectroscopy. Two emission peaks, referred to as Peak H and Peak L, are observed in both PL and EL spectra, due to the ground state splitting induced by the well coupling.

pmc-11827078.title: Dataset on SERS spectra of amber and amber-like resins
pmc-11827078.creator: Anna Kundalevich, Aleksandr Zozulya, Andrey Zyubin, Maksim Bahdasarau, Ilia Samusev
pmc-11827078.description: The article presents experimental data on SERS spectroscopy of amber and amber-like resins of K1 and K2 geological age. The data includes preprocessed SERS of amber and amber-like resins, obtained to identify markers that determine spectral characteristics of natural resin and its deposits.

pmc-12565076.title: Damage Control Surgery in Obstetrics and Gynecology: Abdomino-Pelvic Packing in Multimodal Hemorrhage Management
pmc-12565076.creator: Stoyan Kostov, Yavor Kornovski, Angel Yordanov, Stanislav Slavchev, Yonka Ivanova, Ibrahim Alkatout, Rafał Watrowski
pmc-12565076.description: Damage control surgery (DCS) is a staged surgical strategy for rapid control of life-threatening bleeding, followed by physiological stabilization and delayed definitive repair. Abdomino-pelvic packing (APP)—placing compressive material within the pelvis and/or abdomen to tamponade bleeding—is a cornerstone of DCS as a temporizing measure to achieve hemostasis and stabilization in critically unstable patients.

pmc-12604704.title: Changes in estimated glomerular filtration rate after percutaneous nephrolithotomy in patients with stage 2–4 chronic kidney disease
pmc-12604704.creator: Amr H. Abou Faddan, Mohamed Abdelghany, Adel Kurkar, Ahmed M. Moeen, Mohammed A. Gadalla
pmc-12604704.description: Background and Objective:Percutaneous nephrolithotomy (PCNL) is the gold standard technique used for the treatment of large renal stones ≥ 2 cm. However, in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), the effect of PCNL remains underreported. We aimed to prospectively evaluate the changes in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) after PCNL in patients with stage 2–4 CKD.
